name: MCP Server Chart
headline: mcp-server-chart: Advanced Data Visualization Tool
short_description: We build custom AI skills and automations for B2B companies.
author: antvis

sections.overview:
mcp-server-chart is an MCP server that integrates chart visualization capabilities into AI agents like Claude and Cursor. Built on the AntVis charting library, it enables agents to generate visual representations of data for analytics and reporting. The skill supports multiple chart types to help users transform raw data into actionable insights. This tool is particularly useful for workflows requiring automated data visualization, business intelligence reporting, and exploratory data analysis. Agents can leverage this skill to create visualizations programmatically without manual chart creation.
Creating interactive dashboards to visualize marketing performance metrics.
Analyzing sales trends over time with various chart types to identify patterns.
Generating comprehensive reports for data-driven presentations to stakeholders.
Visualizing customer insights to tailor targeted marketing campaigns effectively.
sections.usage:
```
Generate a comprehensive mcp-server-chart for [PROJECT_NAME] using the following dataset: [DATASET]. Include at least 5 different chart types to visualize trends, comparisons, and distributions. Highlight key insights such as [KEY_INSIGHT_1], [KEY_INSIGHT_2], and [KEY_INSIGHT_3].
```
Copy

```
The mcp-server-chart for the Q3 Sales Performance of XYZ Corp has been successfully generated. The dashboard includes a line chart showing the monthly sales trend, a bar chart comparing sales across different regions, a pie chart illustrating the market share of top products, a scatter plot analyzing the relationship between sales and marketing spend, and a heatmap visualizing customer engagement levels. Key insights include a 20% increase in sales in the Western region, a significant drop in sales for Product A, and a strong correlation between higher marketing spend and increased sales. The dashboard also highlights that customer engagement is highest during promotional periods.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
